capability_results.summary: The clean-HEAD build, Desktop Browser matrix, Local sidecar schema-v2 authority, and native Local Cron Jobs flow were verified. The capability cannot pass because authorized matched-state Web and Cloud Desktop evidence was unavailable and the locked macOS session prevented Computer Use verification.

parity_judgment.statement: Full Cron Jobs equivalence remains pending until the same authorized Web and Cloud Desktop project state and native Computer Use focus boundary are retained alongside the Local Electron evidence.

intentional_deviation.statement: Local Cron intentionally reuses the native Automations domain model and sidecar scheduler instead of creating a second scheduling authority.

input.observation_summary: Local Cron reuses the native AutomationsPage, automationClient, and sidecar scheduler without creating a second scheduling authority. Sidecar schema-v2 allowed actions govern CRUD and toggle, while run-now is disabled when durable_execution is false. Local Electron/CDP observations passed, but the capability result remains blocked because Cloud and matched Web evidence are missing and Computer Use was blocked by the locked Mac session.

output.summary: The intentional deviation is accepted: Local Cron correctly reuses the existing native Automations and sidecar scheduling authority, with mutations and run-now constrained by structured sidecar capabilities. This acceptance applies only to the declared authority-reuse deviation and does not establish overall parity.

judgment_audit.rationale: The observed implementation preserves a single Local scheduling authority rather than duplicating scheduler state or command semantics in the renderer. AutomationsPage consumes the shared automation client, the sidecar remains the mutation and execution authority, schema-v2 allowed actions deterministically gate CRUD and toggle, and durable_execution=false disables run-now. These facts support the declared intentional deviation. They do not resolve the separate Cloud or matched Web evidence requirements, and the locked macOS session prevented Computer Use validation; therefore the overall capability result must remain blocked and no full parity pass is inferred.

build.command: make -C agi-stack desktop-check && make -C agi-stack desktop-browser-qa && node contracts/desktop-web-parity/generate-parity-manifest-v2.mjs --check
build.summary: Clean detached HEAD passed sidecar, Desktop, Electron production build, Browser QA, and parity-manifest drift gates.

browser.summary: The Desktop Browser matrix passed 417 cases, including Automations fixtures, but matched-state Web versus Cloud Desktop evidence was blocked by the absence of an authorized Cloud project session.

native.summary: The make-launched Electron process and its sidecar verified the Local canonical route, schema-v2 authority, deep-link recovery, editor Escape and focus return, route history, no embedded Web content, and zero runtime errors. Cloud native verification and Computer Use window-focus proof remained blocked.
